nodes.label: Local-only by design (no account, sync, telemetry)
nodes.norm_label: local-only by design (no account, sync, telemetry)
nodes.rationale: Connection details, passwords and half-written DELETEs never leave the Mac; settings are TOML files, passwords in Keychain.

nodes.label: Never on the wishlist (accounts, cloud sync, telemetry, background scans)
nodes.norm_label: never on the wishlist (accounts, cloud sync, telemetry, background scans)
nodes.rationale: Party of one: no team plans, shared workspaces or presence; local by design.

nodes.label: Statement classification from parsed SQL (sqlparser), never regex
nodes.norm_label: statement classification from parsed sql (sqlparser), never regex
nodes.rationale: Catches statements inside CTEs, EXPLAIN ANALYZE and multi-statement runs; unparseable text falls back to tokenizer splitting at top-level semicolons, untokenizable text counts as unreadable and asks.

nodes.label: Tiny: system webview, no bundled browser
nodes.norm_label: tiny: system webview, no bundled browser
nodes.rationale: Uses the macOS-shipped webview instead of bundling a browser; heavy lifting is Rust.

nodes.label: runs() SQL highlighter tokenizer
nodes.rationale: Copy of the app's highlighter (src/lib/sql.ts) so the live editor paints like the others; FROM counts only where the paren level holds SELECT/DELETE.

nodes.label: Saved diagram (tables, positions, zoom, detail)
nodes.rationale: Save (Cmd+S) is explicit: nothing is kept on its own, no listener writes on change or drag. Stored with the connection's workspace (~/.config/ypacapy); Show diagram reopens it as saved without the picker. Tables ticked after save are placed to the right; an altered saved table keeps its place and takes its new size.

nodes.label: dup() (duplicate connection)
nodes.rationale: The copy lands right after the original and stays out of the DOM until duplicated, so search and group counts never see it.

nodes.label: rename() / keep() (group rename in place)
nodes.rationale: Enter or blur keeps the new name; Escape puts the old one back.

nodes.label: Card drag-and-drop between groups
nodes.rationale: Pointer-driven as voidHTTP's tree: drag starts after 5px so a click still opens the card; the click ending a drag is swallowed; own group is not a target; edges auto-scroll; Escape drops nothing; dropping on the new-group zone opens the New group dialog.

nodes.label: Connection groups (Production, Staging, Ungrouped)
nodes.rationale: A group exists only through its connections: the last card moved out removes the group. Groups fold, rename in place and can be ungrouped without losing connections.

nodes.norm_label: connection search (name, host, user, database, file, engine, group; cmd+f, enter opens first, esc clears)
nodes.rationale: Search works on whichever list is showing, opens folded groups while active, and clearing it restores every fold as it was. A group name hit shows the whole group.

nodes.rationale: Ungroup keeps the connections; they move to Ungrouped.

Under Strict the list is locked until the passphrase unlocks it.

nodes.norm_label: options tab security: level, open with touch id, stay unlocked for

nodes.norm_label: redis key tree read with scan, grouped into folders by key separator

nodes.norm_label: settings security pane (app-wide passphrase, default level for new connections)

nodes.norm_label: passphrase sub-dialogs (set, change, disable, reset/forgot, unlock)
